# Bitling

> Deterministic pixel avatar identicons for Node.js and browsers: one white
> robot shared by everyone and a personal coloured sigil above it. The same
> `userId` plus the same secret always produce the same avatar. Zero runtime
> dependencies, SVG and PNG output.

Install: `npm install @kotuke/bitling` (Node.js 20+, ESM only).

## Core API

```js
import {
  createAvatarDescriptor,
  generateAvatarPng,
  generateAvatarSvg,
  renderAvatarPng,
  renderAvatarSvg,
  avatarEtag,
  normalizeSize,
  PALETTE,
  AVATAR_VERSION,   // "v1"
} from "@kotuke/bitling";

// One-shot helpers
const svg = generateAvatarSvg(userId, { secret, size, title }); // string
const png = generateAvatarPng(userId, { secret, size });        // Buffer

// Reuse one seed for both formats
const descriptor = createAvatarDescriptor(userId, { secret });
renderAvatarSvg(descriptor, { size, title });
renderAvatarPng(descriptor, { size });
```

Options:

- `secret` — required string, at least 16 characters. Keep it on the backend.
- `size` — integer 32…2048, default 256. Out of range throws `RangeError`.
- `title` — SVG accessible title, escaped automatically.

Errors: empty `userId` or non-string throws `TypeError`; a short secret or a bad
size throws `RangeError`. Nothing is written before validation.

## Browser entry point

```js
import { generateAvatarSvg } from "@kotuke/bitling/browser";
```

Same avatars byte for byte, seeded by a bundled SHA-256 instead of
`node:crypto`. SVG only — PNG needs zlib and stays Node-side.

## HTTP server

```js
import { createAvatarServer } from "@kotuke/bitling/server";
const server = createAvatarServer({ secret, maxCacheEntries: 512 });
```

Routes: `GET /avatars/v1/<urlencoded-id>.(svg|png)?size=512` and `GET /health`.
Responses carry `ETag`, `Cache-Control: immutable` and CORS headers.

## Descriptor shape

```js
{ version, fingerprint, accent, pixels: [[column, row], …] }
```

`pixels` is the personal sigil only — the robot and the grid are shared by every
avatar. `fingerprint` is the first 16 bytes of the HMAC as lowercase hex; the raw
`userId` never appears in the output.

## Behaviour worth knowing

- Determinism key: `AVATAR_VERSION + AVATAR_SECRET + userId`. Changing the secret
  rotates every avatar; bump `AVATAR_VERSION` and serve `/avatars/v2/...` when the
  algorithm changes.
- Sigils are bilaterally symmetric, connected, never overlap the robot.
- Visual collisions are possible in principle: 11 repeats per 100,000 users on
  the reference secret.
- Throughput on the build machine: SVG ≈ 0.09 ms, PNG ≈ 0.6 ms per avatar at
  256×256.
